BrochureContent.Content:
Kennedy Estate Agents present this iconic home which has been lovingly renovated by the current owners. This truly unique property offers distinctive visual appeal and charm with an attractive red brick façade, turret and spire. The property was constructed in circa 1898 and features in the National Inventory of Architectural Heritage's list as being of artistic and architectural interest. 
The internal décor is equally as fascinating with a perfect blend of textures, colours and tasteful finishes. The navy, modern kitchen with quartz countertops provide a most useful contemporary space finished with attractive brass fixtures & fittings. 
This exceptional home is further enhanced by the private garden offering a gravelled seating area, garden shed and dual gated access. The property would make an ideal lock-up and leave townhouse due to the low-maintenance required. Equally first time buyers, downsizers and those looking for an unusual property that exudes character undoubtably will be interested. 

Location: 
Ideally located a 3 minute walk from Main Street, Midleton, the property enjoys immediate access to a host of shops, cafés, restaurants, and everyday conveniences. Midleton's Farmers Market which takes place every Saturday morning offers an opportunity to browse and purchase artisanal local products. Talbot Hotel Midleton is located directly adjacent the property offering bar, restaurant, gym and leisure centre facilities. Market Green shopping centre is also a stone's throw away with an An Post, Tesco, choice of cafés, and ladies / menswear stores. Supervalu, Lidl and Aldi are also within walking distance. For coastal escapes, beautiful beaches such as Whitebay, Inch, and Garryvoe are all within a short drive. 

Accommodation:
Ground Floor:
Entrance Hallway: 
Welcoming hallway with feature patterned floor tiles. 
Living Room: 
Cosy, moody living room overlooking the garden. Walnut affect laminate flooring, wood burning stove with feature brick surround and recessed shelving. 
Open Plan Kitchen/Dining Area: 
Fully fitted navy kitchen (2023), with quartz countertops and splashback. Integrated electric hob, oven, microwave/combi oven, fridge/freezer and dishwasher. Laminate flooring throughout, dual aspect and feature work station. Original cast iron fireplace (currently not in use). Plumbed for washing machine and dryer. 
Back Hallway:
Tiled flooring and door to rear.
Cloakroom:
Plumbed for washing machine and dryer. 
Guest Toilet: 
Charachterful with WC, wash hand basin and tiled flooring. 
First Floor:
Bedroom 1:
Double room overlooking garden and carpet flooring. 
Bedroom 2:
Front aspect room with carpet flooring, feature wall panelling and original cast iron fireplace (currently not in use). 
Bedroom 3:
Front aspect and fully shelved. Currently being used as a walk-in wardrobe. 
Shower Room:
WC, wash hand basin and electric shower. 

Notable features:
Fully renovated townhouse in unbeatable location.
Walking distance to all amenities. 
3 minutes' walk from Midleton's Main Street. 
Ideal short-term rental opportunity. 
Bursting with history, character and charm. 
Unusual, appealing exterior and modern internal décor. 
Fully enclosed, low-maintenance garden with shed. 
Stira fitted to floored attic space. 
Newly fitted carpets- 2025. 
Gas fired central heating. 
Built in circa 1898. 
BER Exempt. 
Approx. 900 sq. ft. 
Eircode: P25 A447. 

Included in sale: All carpets, blinds, light fitting and kitchen appliances i.e. hob, oven, microwave/combi oven, fridge/freezer, dishwasher and washing machine. Garden shed also included. 

For more information please contact: 
Kyle Kennedy, 
Kennedy Estate Agents.
